descriptionChirho: To wean a child from its mother's milk, used both actively (mother weaning) and passively (child being weaned).
To act generously or kindly toward someone, dealing well or bestowing benefit without the connotation of repayment.
To give back in return for what was done, whether rewarding good or repaying evil, implying reciprocal dealing.
To ripen or bring fruit to maturity, said of a plant or vine producing ripe fruit.
